messages.subject: Project Quartz - signed and completed
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor, Gregory,

Delighted to confirm the QX-Clock Patent and Know-How Licence with Caldera Defence was executed today. The upfront fee of 4.5m is due within five business days. Attached are the executed licence (PDF) and the final completion checklist for your records. Congratulations to the whole team.

Sarah
